_comment: Who may run what. Read by app/rbac.py at startup and by POST /api/engine/refresh.
Semantics: a workflow is allowed when its id is listed OR its category is listed.
A role that is absent from this file gets nothing; admin cannot be restricted here.
Model folders restrict what /api/models, /api/models/catalog and the gallery show;
deleting a model, downloading one and changing settings stay admin-only in the routes.
max_active_jobs can only tighten the global STUDIO_MAX_USER_ACTIVE_JOBS ceiling.
